proposal.reason: Trial 1 on the active single_word route used C=0.3 and achieved primary search macro_f1 0.48427983735093977, with very low spam recall. The available single_word_C3.0 candidate keeps the same word representation and logistic classifier but changes C from the recorded 0.3 to 3.0, which is weaker regularization on the same penalized parameterization. This is a controlled next probe on the active route rather than an untested representation jump.
proposal.review: Candidate single_word_C3.0 is available, untried, declared as logistic, and matches the single_text task kind. Its C=3.0 is weaker regularization than the recorded trial C=0.3. No confirmation split or statistical test is available, so this is a search-split proposal only.
proposal.hypothesis: Weaker regularization on word features may allow spam-associated terms to receive more weight and reduce the majority-class bias seen in trial 1, but it may also overfit; the effect on macro_f1 is not known.
proposal.uncertainty: Only one completed primary search trial exists. The observed macro_f1 is low because spam recall is near zero, but the proposed C increase may not correct that imbalance and could worsen generalization. Direction and magnitude of macro_f1 change are unknown.
